provenance.asset_description: The iconic technomancer and iconic witchwarper stand amid a force of invading aliens with batlike features. Bands of metal restrain one of the aliens attacking the technomancer, while the witchwarper directs a swarm of small insects, pouring through a portal to another world, at another invader
